conflicts.reason: Nintendo JP gives millimetre precision and states that projecting parts are excluded; Nintendo of Europe rounds to centimetres (16 cm) and its 11.4 cm height likely includes the feet. Nothing on either page says so; recorded for a human check.

notes: BODY: Nintendo JP 'This is NINTENDO GAMECUBE' page (also on the spec page https://www.nintendo.co.jp/ngc/specific/index.html), labelled W/H/D and '（突起部分を除く）' (excluding projecting parts) → excludes_projections true. Nintendo of Europe's Technical Details page labels '11.4cm (Height) x 15cm (Width) x 16cm (Depth)' (cm, shifted to mm 114/150/160). The two disagree on height and depth; both in conflicts[], Nintendo JP chosen.

ports: Nintendo JP 入出力 row (the original model with digital AV): controller ports ×4 → controller_proprietary 4; memory card slots ×2 → memory_card 2; analogue AV out ×1 → multi_av_out 1 (the manual calls it 'ANALOG AV OUT (Multi Out Connector)'); serial ports ×2 + high-speed parallel port ×1 → expansion 3; power from the US manual's 'DC Input Connector (DC 12V IN)' → power_in 1. 'デジタルAV出力 ×1' (Digital AV out) has no §3 kind and is not filed; the spec page notes that units shipped from July 2004 may lack it (DOL-101 in NA). Nintendo of Europe's I/O row agrees: 'Controller Port x4, Memory Card Slot x2, Analogue AV Output x1, Digital AV Output x1, High-Speed Serial Port x2, High-speed Parallel Port x1'.

media/controls/handle: Nintendo of America's GameCube instruction manual (archived copy of nintendo.com/consumer/downloads/gcn_manual_english.pdf, PDF title '45979E-DOLmanRevE', © 2001-2004), section '1• COMPONENTS': Disc Cover (top view) opened by the Open Button → disc_lid 1; Power Button → power_button; Reset Button → reset_button; Open Button ('Opens disc cover') → eject_button; Handle → features.handle true. Quotes extracted with pypdf from the archived PDF (born-digital, not OCR).
The AC adapter is external ('AC Adapter DC12V x 3.25A'); the inlet's connector form is not named, so features.power_inlet stays null. Mass: no Nintendo page or manual read prints it; null.
